Quick Start

Quick Reference Cheat Sheet

Use this table to immediately locate where to make routine website updates without guessing.

Routine Administrative Task Where to Go in Left Sidebar Key Button / Action
Edit Text on Main Pages
(Home, About, Messages, Constitution, Contact)		 Pages → All Pages Click page title → edit text → click Update
Add a New Ambassador Members → Add New Member Fill Name, Address, Phone, Email → click Publish
Update EC Leadership List Executive Committee → Add New EC Member Enter Name, Serial, Position & check Term → click Publish
Post an Official Notice / Circular Notices → Add New Notice Enter title, paste text, attach PDF link → click Publish
Publish an Article or Book Review Articles & Books → Add New Article Fill author, source, language, body → click Publish
Upload Photos to Photo Gallery Photo Gallery → Add New Photo Click Select / Upload Multiple Photos → click Publish
Upload a PDF Document Media → Add Media File Upload file → click Copy URL to clipboard
Edit the Top Navigation Bar Appearance → Menus Drag & drop menu cards → click Save Menu
Add New Staff Account Users → Add New User Fill email & name → choose role Editor → save
Golden Rule of Web Editing: Whenever you make a change, it will only become visible to the public once you click the blue Update or Publish button at the top right of your screen.
Chapter 1

Getting Started & Logging In

1.1 Accessing the Administration Portal

The AOFA website administration portal is accessible through any modern web browser (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Safari, or Firefox).

  1. Open your browser and navigate to the admin address:
    Live Production Site: https://aofabd.org/wp-admin
    (Local Development Site: http://localhost:8080/wp-admin)
  2. The secure login screen will appear:
Figure 1.1: Official AOFA WordPress Portal Login Screen
  1. Enter your assigned Username or Email Address.
  2. Enter your secure Password.
  3. (Optional) Check Remember Me if on a private, trusted computer.
  4. Click the blue Log In button.

1.2 Navigating the Admin Dashboard

After logging in, your Admin Dashboard will open. This is your mission control center.

Figure 1.2: WordPress Administration Dashboard with Left Navigation Panel

The dashboard has three primary zones:

  • Left Navigation Sidebar (Dark Charcoal): Contains all content management sections (Members, Notices, Articles & Books, Photo Gallery, Pages, Media, Appearance).
  • Top Black Bar (Admin Bar): Shows a home link to view the public website, and your account menu on the far right.
  • Main Work Area (Center): Where you enter information, edit pages, and review member directories.

1.3 Resetting Your Password

If you forget your password, click "Lost your password?" on the login screen, enter your registered email address, and an automated reset link will be sent to your inbox.

1.4 Safe Log Out

To safely sign out, hover your mouse over "Howdy, [Your Name]" at the top right of the screen, and click Log Out.

Chapter 2

Editing Website Pages & Text

2.1 Finding the Page to Edit

Informational pages (such as About AOFA, Constitution, President's Messages, and Contact Us) are stored in the Pages section.

  1. Click Pages → All Pages in the left sidebar.
  2. You will see a list of all existing website pages:
Figure 2.1: Master Pages List in WordPress Admin
  1. Hover over the name of the page you want to update (e.g. About AOFA).
  2. Click on the Page Title or the Edit link.

2.2 The Visual Block Editor

WordPress uses an intuitive visual editor where each paragraph, heading, or image is an editable block.

Figure 2.2: Visual Block Editor Interface showing text blocks and right-hand settings

2.3 How to Format Text

  • Typing & Editing: Click directly into any text block and type or delete words just like in Microsoft Word.
  • Bold or Italic: Highlight words and click B or I on the floating toolbar.
  • Adding New Blocks: Click the blue (+) button at the top left to add a Paragraph, Heading, or List.
  • Adding Hyperlinks: Highlight text, click the chain-link icon (∞), paste your web address (e.g. https://mofa.gov.bd), and press Enter.
  • Saving Your Changes: Click the blue Update button at the top right.
Chapter 3

Managing Media & PDF Documents

3.1 The Media Library

The Media Library holds all photographs, official documents, PDFs, logos, and emblems.

Figure 3.1: WordPress Media Library showing uploaded images and documents

3.2 Uploading Files (PDFs & Photos)

  1. In the left sidebar, click Media → Add Media File.
  2. Drag files from your computer folder directly onto the dashed box, or click Select Files.
  3. The upload completes automatically in a few seconds.

3.3 Creating a "Download PDF" Link or Button

  1. Go to Media → Library and click on your uploaded PDF.
  2. In the popup window, find the File URL field on the right and click Copy URL to clipboard.
  3. Open the page or notice where you want the link (e.g. the Constitution page).
  4. Type text like "Click here to download the AOFA Constitution (PDF)", highlight it, click the Link icon, and paste the URL.
  5. Click Update to save the page.
Image Best Practices: Keep photograph file sizes between 200 KB and 800 KB. Avoid uploading raw 15 MB photos straight from professional cameras, as this slows down page loading on smartphones.
Chapter 4.1

Members Directory (Ambassadors)

The AOFA website maintains a database of former BCS(FA) career ambassadors, divided into Regular and Honorary members.

Figure 4.1: Member Directory List with Member Types (Regular / Honorary)

How to Add a New Ambassador

  1. Click Members → Add New Member in the left sidebar.
  2. Ambassador Name: Enter their full diplomatic title and name in the top box (e.g. Amb. Dr. Muhammad Azizur Rahman).
  3. Scroll down to the Member Details box:
Figure 4.2: Dedicated Member Details Form (Member No, Address, Phone, Email)
  1. Fill in the fields:
    • Member No / Serial: Official membership registration serial number.
    • Address: Residential or mailing address in Dhaka / overseas.
    • Phone: Primary telephone / mobile contact number.
    • Email: Official or personal email address.
  2. Member Type: In the right sidebar panel, check either regular or honorary.
  3. Portrait Photo: In the right sidebar, click Set featured image and select their photo.
  4. Click the blue Publish button at the top right.
Chapter 4.2

Executive Committee Management

The Executive Committee (EC) roster is organized into biennial governance terms (e.g. 2022–2023, 2024–2025, 2026–2027).

Figure 4.3: Executive Committee Management Roster by Committee Term

Adding an Executive Committee Member

  1. Click Executive Committee → Add New EC Member in the left sidebar.
  2. Title Box: Enter the name and title (e.g. Amb. Jahangir Saadat – Vice President-I).
  3. Executive Committee Details Box:
    • Serial No: Enter 1 for President, 2 for Vice President-I, 3 for Vice President-II, 4 for Secretary General, 5 for Treasurer, etc. This enforces proper diplomatic protocol order.
    • Position: Type the portfolio title (e.g. President or Secretary General).
    • Term: Enter the term period (e.g. 2026-2027).
  4. Committee Terms (Right Sidebar): Check the box corresponding to their term (e.g. 2026-2027).
  5. Photo: Click Set featured image to attach their official portrait.
  6. Click Publish.
Chapter 4.3 & 4.4

Notices, Articles & Book Reviews

4.3 Official Notices & Circulars

Used for publishing AGM circulars, election schedules, picnics, and official announcements.

Figure 4.4: Notice Publishing Interface
  1. Click Notices → Add New Notice.
  2. Enter the headline (e.g. "Notice of 12th Annual General Meeting (AGM) 2026").
  3. Paste the announcement body text in the content editor.
  4. If there is a signed physical circular, attach the PDF download link (see Chapter 3.3).
  5. Click Publish. The notice immediately appears on the website homepage and notice archive.

4.4 Articles & Book Reviews

Allows publishing scholarly articles, diplomatic memoirs, and book reviews authored by members.

Figure 4.5: Article Details Form with Author, Publication Citation & Language Selector
  1. Click Articles & Books → Add New Article.
  2. Fill the fields in the Article Details box:
    • Author / Reviewer: e.g. Amb. M. Humayun Kabir
    • Originally Published In: e.g. The Daily Star
    • Language: Choose English or Bengali from the dropdown.
  3. Under Article Categories (right sidebar), check Article or Book Review.
  4. Attach book cover or portrait via Set featured image and click Publish.
Chapter 4.5

Photo Gallery & Event Albums

Showcases diplomatic galas, delegations, picnics, and general assemblies using a high-speed multi-photo batch uploader.

Figure 4.6: One-Click Multiple Photo Upload System for Event Albums

How to Upload an Event Album

  1. Click Photo Gallery → Add New Photo.
  2. Enter the Album Event Title (e.g. "AOFA Diplomatic Gala Dinner 2026").
  3. In the Gallery Album Photos box, click the blue button: Select / Upload Multiple Photos.
  4. In the media window, select multiple photos simultaneously (hold Ctrl on Windows or Cmd on Mac) and click Select.
  5. Thumbnails of all chosen pictures appear in the album grid instantly. Click the small red (×) on any photo to remove it.
  6. Click Set featured image in the right sidebar to designate the main album cover.
  7. Click Publish. The album is now live on the website.
Chapter 5

Managing the Navigation Menu

The navigation menu across the top of the website directs visitors to all key sections.

Figure 5.1: Navigation Menu Builder with Drag-and-Drop Sub-items

5.1 Opening the Menu Editor

Go to Appearance → Menus in the left sidebar. Ensure Primary Menu is selected.

5.2 Adding Links to the Navigation Bar

  1. Under Add menu items on the left, click Pages → View All.
  2. Check the box next to any page you want to show and click Add to Menu.
  3. The new link card will appear at the bottom of the right-hand structure.

5.3 Reordering & Creating Dropdown Sub-menus

  • To Reorder: Click and drag any menu item card up or down.
  • To Create a Dropdown Sub-menu: Drag an item underneath another and slide it slightly to the right until it indents. It will display a sub item badge.
Always Save: Click the blue Save Menu button at the bottom right. Menu modifications are not saved automatically.
Chapter 6 & 7

Security, User Roles & Troubleshooting

6.1 User Roles & Safe Delegation

When giving website access to new office staff (Users → Add New User):

  • Editor (Recommended for staff): Can create, edit, and publish pages, members, notices, and galleries. Cannot break plugins, themes, or core settings.
  • Administrator: Full technical control. Reserve strictly for primary system managers.

7.1 Frequently Asked Questions & Common Fixes

Problem / Question Solution
I updated a page, but the old text still appears on the live site! Your browser has cached the old page. Press Ctrl + F5 (Windows) or Cmd + Shift + R (Mac) to force-refresh the latest version.
How do I temporarily unpublish something without deleting it? Open the item, look in the right sidebar under Status, change it from Published to Draft, and click Save Draft.
I accidentally deleted a member or notice. Can I recover it? Yes! Go to the section list, click the Trash link at the top, hover over the item, and click Restore (kept for 30 days).
Can I see my changes before making them public? Yes. While in the editor, click the Preview button in the top toolbar to view the page exactly as visitors will see it.
Emergency Technical Support:
For hosting renewals, domain configurations, or automated server backups, contact the designated AOFA Technical Webmaster or hosting provider.
